notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We want to give you an honest update on how things are going with Train Mechanic Simulator. We know a lot of you have been waiting eagerly to jump into the game, and we’re super grateful for all the excitement and support you’ve shown us so far. It means the world to us and motivates us to go the extra mile every day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393282/1156032e24495e74ae37b0959179d0d9e1c838b6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393282/37ac8d1779e9483ecc0835872c3291742ded9dbf.png

The truth is, we’re really pushing to make this game not just good but great. We want Train Mechanic Simulator to be more than just another sim—you should feel like you’re truly immersed in the world of train mechanics, with all the hands-on complexity, detail, and realism that come with it. That’s why we’ve been working closely with our community, taking in your feedback, ideas, and suggestions to make sure we’re building something that’s not only fun and engaging but also resonates with the passion you all share for trains and mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393282/10866adf9a4637529d1b62c302c04b82ebeb5aca.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393282/37ac8d1779e9483ecc0835872c3291742ded9dbf.png

That said, making a game that’s unique and polished takes time. We don’t want to rush this, so after a lot of consideration, we’ve decided to move the launch to 2025. We’ll be updating the name of the project accordingly. We hope you will enjoy the vision and depth we’re putting into this project. We’re making every effort to craft an experience that’ll be worth the wait!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393282/bbd04453d84d8b0959a50cc418d7f5ebaa7b701e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393282/37ac8d1779e9483ecc0835872c3291742ded9dbf.png

We’ll keep you updated on our progress and any cool new features we add along the way. We know waiting isn’t easy, and we really appreciate your patience and trust as we work hard to bring you something special. Stay tuned, and thank you again for being such an amazing community!

Add Train Mechanic Simulator 2025 to your wishlist pls!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1773220/Train_Mechanic_Simulator_2025/

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2017 - Now with Steam cards, badges and backgrounds
notes.content:
Hello, Train Mechanics!

Thank you very much for the warm welcome! While browsing through your posts on the forum, there were a lot of threads about the lack of cards and Steam badges.

We wanted to change that and from now on you will have the opportunity to get them in Train Mechanic Simulator 2017. Besides, we added some new flashy train theme emoticons that you will be able to use during the Steam chat. Of course, once you unlock them.

We would like to remind you that we are still collecting your suggestions for the next Train Mechanic Simulator. Can you share your feedback, ideas about the next iteration with us? What's important to you in the game? Which mechanics should we improve? What do you think the new Train Mechanic should look like? Share your thoughts with us on the game's steam forum.


Best Regards,
Atomic Jelly

notes.title: Train Mechanic Simulator 2017 Support
notes.content:
Dear, Train Mechanics

We are very pleased to meet you! We have a big announcement. From now on, our team we'll be handling Train Mechanic Simulator 2017 support. We will scrupulously go through all the old posts and try to give an answer. If you have any questions about the game we encourage you to ask them. We will try to respond and contribute to the Train Mechanic community with full professionalism and commitment. We encourage you to be active!


By the way, we're starting to think about the next Train Mechanic Simulator, so we have a huge request. Can you share your suggestions, ideas about the next iteration with us? What's important to you in the game? What mechanics should we improve? What do you think the new Train Mechanic should look like?

We want you to take an active part in the preparations, we're making this game for you. We want you to be satisfied with the final product. Let's do it together!

Best Regards,
Atomic Jelly

- Small Fixes&Changes
